primary_deployment: deterministic argmax of final weights; no checkpoint selection
primary_evaluation: Exact finite-population expectation, not a held-out-state generalization claim

success_criteria.private_goal: Learned mean success >= .95; every seed exceeds the exact silent .25 bound; positive utility gap
success_criteria.route_safety: Learned mean success >= .95; every seed beats optimal silence in utility; mean packets <= 4.5 (half continuous)
success_criteria.scouting: Warm learned mean utility >= .965 and every seed > .91; ask on expensive hidden contexts, scout on cheap hidden contexts, act silently when already informed
success_criteria.complementary: Warm dialogue mean success >= .95; every seed beats fixed full-map broadcast utility .84; mean accuracy exceeds one-way five-bit information bound

fixed_controls: Explicitly prescribed channel/planner policies, never presented as learned protocols
disclosures: Finite categorical policies, exact expected-reward optimization and known task model
Warm scouting uses 600 extra functional-code updates; warm dialogue uses 1000 extra referential updates
Navigation is a receiver-local BFS planner, not learned motor control
Silence can carry information in private-goal and route tasks
Dialogue charges a presence flag plus query and reply bits
No visual, MuJoCo, compositional-language, or unseen-private-state generalization claim
